scope: One bounded option map for G042 Standard 2D filters, G043 True 3D filters, G044 Filter dialogs and previews and G045 Processing extent. Reuse the six existing rank requirements and owned services. This document changes no requirement, candidate assignment, verification, incorporation or family decision.

classification_policy.reused_implemented_subset: A concrete owned source route exists; its exact qualified scope remains separate from whole-family or upstream compatibility.
classification_policy.missing_behavior: The required user outcome is absent or incomplete in the inspected owned route.
classification_policy.unregistered: No matching option-child requirement is registered; an existing kernel or discovery descriptor does not supply that contract.
classification_policy.explicit_refusal: The current adapter intentionally rejects the stated request; preserve the refusal until an independent extension is adopted.
classification_policy.eligibility_pending: The current candidate commercial review remains pending. Descriptor names and public-domain core lineage do not approve a Fiji component.
classification_policy.unresolved_discovery: The pinned descriptor or family requirement exists, but exact implementation/dialog/runtime contents were not available through the consumed reviewed primary-source links. Do not invent options or defaults.
classification_policy.counting: Descriptors, separators, aliases, methods, option children and executable user workflows are different objects. No descriptor count in this proposal is a feature/completion count. G044 and G045 are crosscutting obligations on operations, not duplicate commands.

options.name: radius
options.bounds: Owned require_radius policy0..4096; distinct from upstream fractional radius

option_groups.types_axes: Image kernel loops interleaved channels; first four methods retain declared Image type, variance/stddev return Float64. Integer disk uses dx*dx+dy*dy<=radius*radius. This is owned compatibility, not an ImageJ1.54r type/arithmetic claim or a scientific desktop adapter.
option_groups.preservation: Keep existing IDs/defaults/records/border/footprint/mean and promoted variance/stddev semantics unchanged. Never replace legacy rank with rank_filter_imagej globally.

primary_methods.name: Variance
primary_methods.controls: Radius initially2 or last positive per-method value; finite dialog range0..1000; Preview; stack setup. Same processor layout is retained, variance is source-ordered sum-of-squares minus square-of-sum divided by point count, clipped to0/maxValue. U16/Float32 final/preview display stretches histogram0.5; byte/RGB skip that display change.
primary_methods.owned_subset: Legacy native variance/stddev Float64 kernels exist; an independently specified promoted scientific child and an exact ImageJ variance compatibility profile are different policies.

primary_methods.name: Despeckle
primary_methods.controls: No rank parameter dialog; converts to Median radius1, then stack setup. Source fractional footprint is not the old native integer-disk radius1.
primary_methods.owned_subset: Median kernels exist; no specifically registered Despeckle workflow/preset.

primary_methods.name: Remove Outliers
primary_methods.controls: Per-method radius initially2; radius slider0.5..25 step0.5, while listener accepts0..100; threshold initially50, slider max max(2*lastThreshold, rawStdDev), listener threshold>=0; Bright/Dark choice initially Bright; Preview; stack setup. Interactive accept remembers radius/threshold/choice; macro options do not.
primary_methods.owned_subset: Owned remove_outliers has integer radius2, threshold50, bright=true and native median semantics; it is not an adopted source-compatible profile.

primary_methods.name: Remove NaNs
primary_methods.controls: Source setup requires32-bit image. Radius initially2/last positive value, accepted0..100, Preview and stack setup. NaN-aware median replaces NaNs.
primary_methods.owned_subset: Current finite rank profile explicitly refuses this input policy; keep refusal and define a separate nonfinite contract.

primary_methods.name: Top Hat
primary_methods.controls: Radius initially2/last positive value, accepted0..1000; Light Background initiallyfalse; Don't subtract (grayscale open) initiallyfalse; Preview; stack setup. Accept remembers those interactive options. Subtraction changes final display policy; no-subtract preserves it.
primary_methods.owned_subset: Owned morphology/background functions are only reusable kernels; no exact linked Top Hat option-child/profile/UI qualification is registered.

primary_methods.name: Show Circular Masks
primary_methods.controls: Source utility builds150x150 Float32 masks for radii0.5 through49.5 step0.5, labels radius/size, and displays a stack. This is a diagnostic/viewing route, not an extra filtering method.
primary_methods.owned_subset: Public rank_filter_kernel_imagej exposes footprint metadata; no equivalent masks-view command is registered.

owned_options_only: convolve: numeric kernel; border reflect/nearest/wrap/constant; cval0; normalize control. Existing catalog/kernel and Image/Python entry points are available.
